name: Our Chapters
description: The homepage roster, now split by status. The four cities that actually hold events sort ahead of the two that are forming, and DC and Seattle carry a Forming - help lead it badge instead of pretending to a calendar they do not have. The count kicker reads 04 cities - 2 forming rather than the flat 6 the site used to claim. The fixture lists the chapters unsorted on purpose, so the frame proves the ordering is the component's work and not the data's.
